official_source.title: LABITCONF 26 — ¿Por qué hodleás?
excerpts: The event #1 of Latin America bringing together people, ideas, and projects redefining money, technology, and the economy through Bitcoin, Blockchain and Artificial Intelligence.
The Experience ticket includes the B2B Networking Event (29 October), Opening Show (29 October), and Speaker's Networking & Chill Out Full Day (1 November).

corroborating_sources.observed_claim: LABITCONF 2026 runs 29 October to 1 November at Costa Salguero, Buenos Aires, Argentina.
The main conference opens 30–31 October 2026 at BAFerial, formerly Costa Salguero, Buenos Aires.
The 29 October executive networking and Satoshi monument event sits alongside the 30–31 October conference.

decision.reason: The organizer-owned site confirms the 2026 edition, venue, main conference dates, and the additional 29 October and 1 November Experience events.
